subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should OpenClaw add this public after-compaction hook reset API now, and should the permanent contract retain compatibility with the earlier unmerged explicit-key call shape?
rationale: Current main has no established plugin reset-hook contract, so API scope and compatibility cannot be selected safely from implementation evidence alone.

options.title: Approve scoped API only
options.body: Adopt the deferred current-session API, remove the unshipped explicit-key compatibility overload, and keep unrelated recovery behavior out of this PR.

options.title: Approve compatibility overload
options.body: Adopt the scoped API while intentionally supporting deployed plugins that used the earlier explicit-key proposal.

options.title: Decline core API
options.body: Keep reset orchestration internal or plugin-local until a broader session-lifecycle API is sponsored.

recommendation.title: Approve scoped API only
recommendation.body: Adopt the deferred current-session API, remove the unshipped explicit-key compatibility overload, and keep unrelated recovery behavior out of this PR.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal is their recent ownership of the gateway session-reset lifecycle and active-work cleanup path.
